name: plectrify-tools
description: Root dev/release tooling, one language on both OSes: `pnpm app` dispatches to scripts/run.windows.ts / run.macos.ts and `pnpm release` to scripts/release.windows.ts / release.macos.ts, with `pnpm release:promote` the separate third step. One `pnpm install` here fetches tsx; ui/ and packaging/ stay their own packages.
